# Create pairwise data with RC and humans
```{r}
# Helper: build one comparison block with standardised column names
make_comparison <- function(df, type, r1, r2,
                            dev1, dev2, prereg1, prereg2, paper1, paper2) {
  df |>
    transmute(
      article_num, study_num, dimension,
      comparison_type = type,
      rater1 = {{ r1 }}, rater2 = {{ r2 }},
      deviation_r1 = {{ dev1 }},    deviation_r2 = {{ dev2 }},
      prereg_r1    = {{ prereg1 }}, prereg_r2    = {{ prereg2 }},
      paper_r1     = {{ paper1 }},  paper_r2     = {{ paper2 }},
      final_deviation_decision, PRE_meeting_comments, POST_meeting_comments
    )
}

pairwise_data <- bind_rows(
  # 1. human vs human
  make_comparison(data_cleaned, "human_human",
                  coder1, coder2,
                  deviation_c1, deviation_c2,
                  prereg_c1, prereg_c2,
                  paper_c1, paper_c2),
  # 2. RegCheck vs coder 1
  make_comparison(data_cleaned, "rc_human",
                  "RC", coder1,
                  regcheck_deviation_judgment, deviation_c1,
                  regcheck_registration_quotes, prereg_c1,
                  regcheck_paper_quotes, paper_c1),
  # 3. RegCheck vs coder 2
  make_comparison(data_cleaned, "rc_human",
                  "RC", coder2,
                  regcheck_deviation_judgment, deviation_c2,
                  regcheck_registration_quotes, prereg_c2,
                  regcheck_paper_quotes, paper_c2)
) |>
  mutate(
    coder_pair      = paste(pmin(rater1, rater2), pmax(rater1, rater2), sep = "_"),  
    deviation_agree = as.integer(deviation_r1 == deviation_r2)) |>
  arrange(article_num, dimension, comparison_type)

```


# Compute cosine similarity
```{r}
data_pairs_cosine <- pairwise_data |>
  select(article_num, study_num, dimension, comparison_type,
         rater1, rater2, coder_pair,
         prereg_r1, prereg_r2, paper_r1, paper_r2) |>
  pivot_longer(c(prereg_r1, prereg_r2, paper_r1, paper_r2),
               names_to = c("source", ".value"),
               names_pattern = "(prereg|paper)_(r[12])") |>
  rename(text_r1 = r1, text_r2 = r2)

is_blank <- function(x) is.na(x) | str_trim(x) == ""

# Embeddings in batches, ordered by the API's index field
get_embeddings <- function(texts,
                           model = "text-embedding-3-large",
                           api_key = Sys.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY"),
                           batch_size = 500) {
  batches <- split(texts, ceiling(seq_along(texts) / batch_size))
  out <- map(batches, function(b) {
    resp <- request("https://api.openai.com/v1/embeddings") |>
      req_auth_bearer_token(api_key) |>
      req_body_json(list(input = as.list(b), model = model)) |>
      req_retry(max_tries = 5) |>
      req_perform()
    d <- resp_body_json(resp)$data
    d <- d[order(map_int(d, "index"))]
    map(d, ~ unlist(.x$embedding))
  })
  emb <- unlist(out, recursive = FALSE, use.names = FALSE)
  names(emb) <- texts
  emb
}

cosine_sim <- function(a, b) sum(a * b) / (sqrt(sum(a^2)) * sqrt(sum(b^2)))
```

```{r eval = FALSE}
# --- TEST ON A FEW ROWS ---
run_embeddings <- FALSE   # set to TRUE only when you want to (re-)embed

if (run_embeddings) {
  test <- data_pairs_cosine |>
    filter(!is_blank(text_r1), !is_blank(text_r2)) |>
    slice_sample(n = 6)

  test_emb <- get_embeddings(unique(c(test$text_r1, test$text_r2)))

  test <- test |>
    mutate(cosine = map2_dbl(text_r1, text_r2, ~ cosine_sim(test_emb[[.x]], test_emb[[.y]]))) |>
    select(dimension, source, comparison_type, text_r1, text_r2, cosine)

  print(length(test_emb[[1]]))
  print(cosine_sim(test_emb[[1]], test_emb[[1]]))
  print(cosine_sim(test_emb[[1]], rev(test_emb[[1]])))
}

```


```{r }
# --- RUN FUNCTIONS ---
# Embed exactly the texts you compare
all_texts <- c(data_pairs_cosine$text_r1, data_pairs_cosine$text_r2)
all_texts <- unique(all_texts[!is_blank(all_texts)])

# Load saved embeddings if they exist; embed only new texts
emb_file <- "embeddings_cleaned_text-embedding-3-large.rds"
embeddings <- if (file.exists(emb_file)) readRDS(emb_file) else list()

to_embed <- setdiff(all_texts, names(embeddings))
message(length(to_embed), " new texts to embed (", length(all_texts) - length(to_embed), " loaded from file)")

if (length(to_embed) > 0) {
  embeddings <- c(embeddings, get_embeddings(to_embed))
  saveRDS(embeddings, emb_file)
}

lookup <- function(text) {
  e <- embeddings[[text]]
  if (is.null(e)) stop("No embedding for: ", str_trunc(text, 60))
  e
}

data_pairs_cosine <- data_pairs_cosine |>
  mutate(cosine = map2_dbl(text_r1, text_r2, function(a, b) {
    if (is_blank(a) || is_blank(b)) return(NA_real_)
    cosine_sim(lookup(a), lookup(b))
  }))

# Sanity checks
stopifnot(!any(is.nan(data_pairs_cosine$cosine)))
stopifnot(all(data_pairs_cosine$comparison_type %in% c("human_human", "rc_human")))
```

# Analysis
## RQ1: Cosine similarity
### Descriptives
#### Overall
```{r}
# M and SD of cosine by source (prereg vs. paper) and comparison type (h-h vs. rc-h)
overall_avg_cos <- data_pairs_cosine |>
  group_by(source, comparison_type) |>
  summarise(n = sum(!is.na(cosine)),
            M = mean(cosine, na.rm = TRUE),
            SD = sd(cosine, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")
overall_avg_cos
```

#### Cosine baselines (not preregistered)
```{r}
# Helper: matrix of normalised embeddings, one row per text
emb_matrix <- function(texts) {
  m <- do.call(rbind, lapply(texts, lookup))
  m / sqrt(rowSums(m^2))
}

hh <- data_pairs_cosine |> filter(comparison_type == "human_human")

# (a) Within-paper: coder 1 dim X vs coder 2 dim Y (X != Y), same paper
within_paper <- hh |>
  group_by(article_num, study_num, source) |>
  group_modify(\(d, key) {
    x <- filter(d, !is_blank(text_r1))
    y <- filter(d, !is_blank(text_r2))
    if (nrow(x) == 0 || nrow(y) == 0) return(tibble(cos = numeric(0)))
    s <- emb_matrix(x$text_r1) %*% t(emb_matrix(y$text_r2))
    tibble(cos = s[outer(x$dimension, y$dimension, "!=")])
  }) |>
  summarise(paper_mean = mean(cos), .groups = "drop") |>   # one value per paper
  group_by(source) |>
  summarise(n = n(), M = mean(paper_mean), SD = sd(paper_mean)) |>
  mutate(comparison_type = "baseline_within_article")

# (b) Between-paper: same dimension, coder 1 paper A vs coder 2 paper B (A != B)
between_paper <- hh |>
  group_by(source, dimension) |>
  group_modify(\(d, key) {
    x <- filter(d, !is_blank(text_r1))
    y <- filter(d, !is_blank(text_r2))
    s <- emb_matrix(x$text_r1) %*% t(emb_matrix(y$text_r2))
    s[!outer(x$article_num, y$article_num, "!=")] <- NA        # drop same-paper pairs
    tibble(article_num = x$article_num, cos = rowMeans(s, na.rm = TRUE))
  }) |>
  group_by(source, article_num) |>
  summarise(paper_mean = mean(cos), .groups = "drop") |>      # one value per paper
  group_by(source) |>
  summarise(n = n(), M = mean(paper_mean), SD = sd(paper_mean)) |>
  mutate(comparison_type = "baseline_between_article")

# Combined table: H–H and RC–H next to both baselines
cosine_summary <- bind_rows(overall_avg_cos, within_paper, between_paper) |>
  mutate(comparison_type = factor(comparison_type,
             levels = c("human_human", "rc_human", "baseline_within_article", "baseline_between_article"))) |>
  arrange(source, comparison_type)

cosine_summary
```

#### Coverage (not preregistered)
```{r}
# This uses ROUGE-1-style word overlap: the share of one text’s words found in the other. It’s fast, easy to explain, and separates “RC got everything plus extra” (high recall, low precision) from “RC got the wrong thing” (both low).

tok <- function(x) str_extract_all(str_to_lower(x), "[a-z0-9]+")[[1]]

# Proportion of b's words also found in a (counts clipped)
overlap_share <- function(a, b) {
  ta <- table(tok(a)); tb <- table(tok(b))
  common <- intersect(names(ta), names(tb))
  sum(pmin(ta[common], tb[common])) / sum(tb)
}

coverage <- data_pairs_cosine |>
  filter(!is_blank(text_r1), !is_blank(text_r2)) |>
  mutate(
    # rater1 = RC in rc_human rows; coder 1 in human_human rows
    recall    = map2_dbl(text_r1, text_r2, overlap_share),  # share of rater2's text covered by rater1
    precision = map2_dbl(text_r2, text_r1, overlap_share)   # share of rater1's text found in rater2's
  )

coverage |>
  group_by(source, comparison_type) |>
  summarise(across(c(recall, precision),
                   list(M = mean, SD = sd), .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"),
            .groups = "drop")

 
# RC–H rows: recall = how much of the human’s extract RC captured; precision = how much of RC’s extract the human also selected.
# H–H rows as a baseline: how much of the one coder’s extract the other captured; precision = how much of one coder’s extract the other coder also selected.
```

#### Length ratios (not preregistered)
```{r }
text_cols <- c("prereg_c1", "prereg_c2", "paper_c1", "paper_c2",
               "regcheck_registration_quotes", "regcheck_paper_quotes")

length_summary <- data_cleaned |>
  select(any_of(text_cols)) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "column", values_to = "text") |>
  filter(!is_blank(text)) |>
  mutate(
    rater   = if_else(str_detect(column, "regcheck"), "RegCheck", "Human"),
    source  = if_else(str_detect(column, "paper"), "paper", "prereg"),
    n_words = str_count(text, "\\S+")
  ) |>
  group_by(source, rater) |>
  summarise(median_words = median(n_words),
            IQR = paste0("[", quantile(n_words, .25), ", ", quantile(n_words, .75), "]"),
            .groups = "drop")

length_summary

length_summary |>
  select(source, rater, median_words) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = rater, values_from = median_words,
              names_glue = "{rater}_median") |>
  mutate(ratio = RegCheck_median / Human_median)
```

### Non-inferiority test
```{r}
# Build the mlm
m_rq1 <- lmer(
  cosine ~ comparison_type + source + (1 | article_num) + (1 | dimension) + (1 | coder_pair) + (1 |  article_num:dimension:source),
  data = data_pairs_cosine
)

# Check for singularity issues
isSingular(m_rq1)

# View the model output
summary(m_rq1)

VarCorr(m_rq1)    

# Non-inferiority check
# criterion: 0.4 x SD of human-human cosine similarity
ni_criterion <- data_pairs_cosine %>%
  filter(comparison_type == "human_human") %>%
  pull(cosine) %>%
  sd(na.rm = TRUE) %>%
  { . * 0.4 }

# Contrast: rc_human vs human_human
# For a one-sided 95% lower bound, use the lower bound of a two-sided 90% CI.
contrast_rq1 <- emmeans(m_rq1, ~ comparison_type) %>%
  contrast(list("rc_human - human_human" = c(-1, 1))) %>%
  confint(level = 0.90)

contrast_rq1

# Non-inferiority check: lower one-sided 95% CI must be above -ni_criterion
# (i.e. RegCheck is not meaningfully worse than human-human)
ifelse(contrast_rq1$asymp.LCL > -ni_criterion, "non-inferior", "inferior")
```

## RQ2: Deviation agreement
### RQ2.i Rater-panel (preregistered)
*Note:* We did not preregister how NAs would be treated (cases where coders indicated that the dimension was not preregistered). For the main analyses, we merge these with the "Too vague to tell/ not reported" category. We also report sensitivity checks that exclude these cases.
```{r}
# Prepare to merge NA with too vague to tell/ not reported
clean_deviation <- function(x) {
  x <- str_trim(x)
  case_when(
    str_detect(x, regex("not pre-?registered", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ NA_character_,
    str_detect(x, regex("too vague|^missing$", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~
      "Preregistration/ Manuscript were too vague to tell or information not reported.",
    str_detect(x, regex("^yes", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Yes",
    str_detect(x, regex("^no",  ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "No",
    TRUE ~ x
  )
}

dev_levels <- c("Deviation", "No deviation", "Too vague")

recode_dev <- function(x) {
  x <- clean_deviation(x)
  case_when(
    x == "Yes" ~ "Deviation",
    x == "No"  ~ "No deviation",
    str_detect(x, "too vague") ~ "Too vague",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

# Recode each rater's judgement, then rebuild agreement two ways
rq2i_data <- pairwise_data %>%
  mutate(
    dev_r1 = recode_dev(deviation_r1),   # <- CHECK: rater 1's deviation judgement (RC on rc_human rows)
    dev_r2 = recode_dev(deviation_r2)    # <- CHECK: rater 2's deviation judgement
  )

# Main analysis: NA -> Too vague (all rows kept)
rq2i_main <- rq2i_data %>%
  mutate(across(c(dev_r1, dev_r2), \(x) coalesce(x, "Too vague")),
         deviation_agree = as.integer(dev_r1 == dev_r2))

# Sensitivity check: rows with an NA from either rater excluded
rq2i_sens <- rq2i_data %>%
  mutate(deviation_agree = as.integer(dev_r1 == dev_r2)) %>%   # NA if either is NA
  filter(!is.na(deviation_agree))

# Checks
rq2i_main %>% count(comparison_type, deviation_agree)
rq2i_sens %>% count(comparison_type, deviation_agree)
```

```{r rq2i-function}
# Set up so that we can easily run the main analysis and sensitivity check
run_rq2i <- function(d) {
  # Multilevel logistic model (as preregistered)
  m <- glmer(
    deviation_agree ~ comparison_type + (1 | article_num) + (1 | dimension) +
      (1 | coder_pair) + (1 | article_num:dimension),
    data   = d,
    family = binomial(link = "logit")
  )

  # Raw agreement (descriptives)
  raw <- d %>%
    summarise(n = n(), agreement = mean(deviation_agree), .by = comparison_type)

  # Non-inferiority criterion: 0.2 x SD of human-human agreement (probability scale)
  hh_agree <- d %>% filter(comparison_type == "human_human") %>% pull(deviation_agree)
  ni <- sd(hh_agree) * 0.2

  # Contrast on the probability scale; one-sided 95% bound = lower bound of two-sided 90% CI
  ct <- emmeans(m, ~ comparison_type) %>%
    regrid("response") %>%
    contrast(list("rc_human - human_human" = c(-1, 1))) %>%
    confint(level = 0.90)

  ci    <- as.data.frame(ct)
  lower <- if ("asymp.LCL" %in% names(ci)) ci$asymp.LCL else ci$lower.CL

  list(
    model        = m,
    singular     = isSingular(m),
    convergence  = m@optinfo$conv$lme4,   # empty list() = no warnings
    raw          = raw,
    ni_criterion = ni,
    contrast     = ct,
    verdict      = ifelse(lower > -ni, "non-inferior", "inferior")
  )
}
```

```{r rq2i-results}
rq2i_res_main <- run_rq2i(rq2i_main)
rq2i_res_sens <- run_rq2i(rq2i_sens)

# Main analysis
rq2i_res_main$singular #singular fit issues?
rq2i_res_main$convergence #did model converge?
summary(rq2i_res_main$model) #model summary
rq2i_res_main$raw #raw agreement comparison
rq2i_res_main$ni_criterion #non-inferiority criterion
rq2i_res_main$contrast
rq2i_res_main$verdict

# Sensitivity check
rq2i_res_sens$singular
rq2i_res_sens$convergence
summary(rq2i_res_sens$model)
rq2i_res_sens$raw
rq2i_res_sens$ni_criterion
rq2i_res_sens$contrast
rq2i_res_sens$verdict
```

### RQ2.ii Reference standard (not preregistered)

```{r rq2ii-data}
# One row per article x dimension (RC-human rows are duplicated, one per human coder)
rq2ii_data <- pairwise_data %>%
  filter(comparison_type == "rc_human") %>%
  distinct(article_num, dimension, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  filter(!coalesce(str_detect(final_deviation_decision,
                              regex("could not agree", ignore_case = TRUE)), FALSE)) %>%
  mutate(
    humans   = recode_dev(final_deviation_decision),
    regcheck = recode_dev(deviation_r1)   # <- CHECK: column holding RC's deviation judgement
  )

# Checks
rq2ii_data %>% count(article_num, dimension) %>% filter(n > 1)    # should be 0 rows
pairwise_data %>%                                               # n excluded as "Could not agree"
  filter(comparison_type == "rc_human") %>%
  distinct(article_num, dimension, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  count(could_not_agree = str_detect(final_deviation_decision,
                                     regex("could not agree", ignore_case = TRUE)))
rq2ii_data %>% count(humans_na = is.na(humans), rc_na = is.na(regcheck))

# Main analysis: NA -> Too vague
rq2ii_main <- rq2ii_data %>%
  mutate(across(c(humans, regcheck),
                \(x) factor(coalesce(x, "Too vague"), levels = dev_levels)))

# Sensitivity check: NA rows excluded
rq2ii_sens <- rq2ii_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(humans), !is.na(regcheck)) %>%
  mutate(across(c(humans, regcheck), \(x) factor(x, levels = dev_levels)))
```

```{r rq2ii-functions}
# One-vs-rest metrics per class (rows = RegCheck, columns = Humans)
ovr <- function(cm) {
  n <- sum(cm)
  map_dfr(rownames(cm), function(k) {
    tp <- cm[k, k]
    fp <- sum(cm[k, ]) - tp   # RC said k, humans said something else
    fn <- sum(cm[, k]) - tp   # humans said k, RC said something else
    tn <- n - tp - fp - fn
    tibble(class       = k,
           sensitivity = tp / (tp + fn),
           ppv         = tp / (tp + fp),
           specificity = tn / (tn + fp),
           npv         = tn / (tn + fn),
           f1          = 2 * tp / (2 * tp + fp + fn))
  })
}

# Multiclass MCC (Gorodkin, 2004)
mcc_multi <- function(cm) {
  s <- sum(cm); c <- sum(diag(cm))
  p <- rowSums(cm)   # RC (predicted) totals
  t <- colSums(cm)   # human (reference) totals
  (c * s - sum(p * t)) / sqrt((s^2 - sum(p^2)) * (s^2 - sum(t^2)))
}

run_rq2ii <- function(d) {
  cm <- table(RegCheck = d$regcheck, Humans = d$humans)
  tb <- ovr(cm)
  tb <- bind_rows(tb, tb %>% summarise(across(-class, mean)) %>%
                    mutate(class = "Macro average"))
  overall <- tibble(
    n                 = sum(cm),
    accuracy          = sum(diag(cm)) / sum(cm),
    balanced_accuracy = mean(tb$sensitivity[tb$class != "Macro average"]),
    macro_f1          = mean(tb$f1[tb$class != "Macro average"]),
    mcc               = mcc_multi(cm)
  )
  list(confusion = cm, by_class = tb, overall = overall)
}
```

```{r rq2ii-results}
rq2ii_res_main <- run_rq2ii(rq2ii_main)
rq2ii_res_sens <- run_rq2ii(rq2ii_sens)

# Table A: confusion matrices (with totals)
addmargins(rq2ii_res_main$confusion)
addmargins(rq2ii_res_sens$confusion)

# Table B: one-vs-rest by class + macro average
rq2ii_res_main$by_class %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 2)))
rq2ii_res_sens$by_class %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 2)))

# Overall summaries: main vs sensitivity
bind_rows(main = rq2ii_res_main$overall, sensitivity = rq2ii_res_sens$overall, .id = "analysis") %>%
  mutate(across(c(accuracy, balanced_accuracy, macro_f1, mcc), \(x) round(x, 2)))

```

## RQ2a: Deviation agreement by dimension

### Build long dataset (main: NA -> Too vague; sensitivity: NA excluded)
```{r rq2a-data}
# One row per rater x article x dimension (for alpha / AC1)
rq2a_ratings <- bind_rows(
  pairwise_data |> select(article_num, study_num, dimension, coder = rater1, deviation = deviation_r1),
  pairwise_data |> select(article_num, study_num, dimension, coder = rater2, deviation = deviation_r2)
) |>
  distinct() |>   # each rating appears in several pairs
  mutate(deviation = recode_dev(deviation))   # Deviation / No deviation / Too vague / NA

# Check: no rater should have >1 rating per article x dimension
rq2a_ratings |> count(article_num, dimension, coder) |> filter(n > 1)

# Main analysis: NA -> Too vague
rq2a_ratings_main <- rq2a_ratings |>
  mutate(deviation     = coalesce(deviation, "Too vague"),
         deviation_num = as.integer(factor(deviation, levels = dev_levels)))

# Sensitivity check: NA ratings excluded
rq2a_ratings_sens <- rq2a_ratings |>
  filter(!is.na(deviation)) |>
  mutate(deviation_num = as.integer(factor(deviation, levels = dev_levels)))
```

### Functions
```{r rq2a-functions}
rc_coder     <- "RC"
human_coders <- setdiff(unique(rq2a_ratings$coder), rc_coder)

human_coders   # check: should list only the human coders

# Krippendorff's alpha by dimension (nominal: categories are unordered)
compute_alpha_by_dim <- function(ratings, coders_filter, level = "nominal") {
  ratings %>%
    filter(coder %in% coders_filter) %>%
    group_by(dimension) %>%
    group_modify(function(d, key) {
      wide <- d %>%
        select(article_num, coder, deviation_num) %>%
        pivot_wider(names_from = coder, values_from = deviation_num) %>%
        select(-article_num) %>%
        as.matrix()
      fit <- tryCatch(
        krippendorffs.alpha(wide, level = level, confint = FALSE),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      tibble(alpha = if (is.null(fit)) NA_real_ else fit$alpha.hat)
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
}

# Gwet's AC1 by dimension (not preregistered; unweighted: categories are unordered)
compute_ac1_by_dim <- function(ratings, coders_filter, wts = "unweighted") {
  ratings %>%
    filter(coder %in% coders_filter) %>%
    group_by(dimension) %>%
    group_modify(function(d, key) {
      wide <- d %>%
        select(article_num, coder, deviation) %>%
        pivot_wider(names_from = coder, values_from = deviation) %>%
        select(-article_num) %>%
        as.data.frame()
      fit <- tryCatch(
        gwet.ac1.raw(wide, weights = wts),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      if (is.null(fit)) {
        tibble(ac1 = NA_real_, ac1_se = NA_real_, ac1_lower = NA_real_, ac1_upper = NA_real_)
      } else {
        tibble(
          ac1       = fit$est$coeff.val,
          ac1_se    = fit$est$coeff.se,
          ac1_lower = fit$est$conf.int %>% str_extract("(?<=\\()[-0-9.]+") %>% as.numeric(),
          ac1_upper = fit$est$conf.int %>% str_extract("[-0-9.]+(?=\\))") %>% as.numeric()
        )
      }
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
}

# All RQ2a outputs for one version of the data
# pairs   = pairwise agreement data from RQ2.i (rq2i_main or rq2i_sens)
# ratings = long ratings (rq2a_ratings_main or rq2a_ratings_sens)
run_rq2a <- function(pairs, ratings) {
  agree <- pairs %>%
    summarise(
      n_total    = n(),
      n_agree    = sum(deviation_agree),
      prop_agree = mean(deviation_agree),
      .by = c(dimension, comparison_type)
    )

  alpha <- compute_alpha_by_dim(ratings, human_coders) %>%
    mutate(comparison_type = "human_human") %>%
    bind_rows(compute_alpha_by_dim(ratings, c(human_coders, rc_coder)) %>%
                mutate(comparison_type = "rc_human"))

  ac1 <- compute_ac1_by_dim(ratings, human_coders) %>%
    mutate(comparison_type = "human_human") %>%
    bind_rows(compute_ac1_by_dim(ratings, c(human_coders, rc_coder)) %>%
                mutate(comparison_type = "rc_human"))

  agree %>%
    left_join(alpha, by = c("dimension", "comparison_type")) %>%
    left_join(ac1,   by = c("dimension", "comparison_type")) %>%
    arrange(dimension, comparison_type)
}
```

### Results
```{r rq2a-results}
rq2a_res_main <- run_rq2a(rq2i_main, rq2a_ratings_main)
rq2a_res_sens <- run_rq2a(rq2i_sens, rq2a_ratings_sens)

rq2a_res_main %>% mutate(across(where(is.double), \(x) round(x, 2)))
rq2a_res_sens %>% mutate(across(where(is.double), \(x) round(x, 2)))

```

Note that from here on, I haven't altered the preregistered code, as these last few RQs require additional data.

### [WIP] Part 1. Deviations only RegCheck identifies
```{r eval = FALSE}
# Wide format: one row per article_num × dimension, one column per coder
rq2b_wide <- pairwise_data %>%
  select(article_num, dimension, coder, deviation, concerns) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = coder, values_from = c(deviation, concerns)) %>%
  rename(
    rc      = paste0("deviation_", rc_coder),
    coder_1 = paste0("deviation_", human_coders[1]),
    coder_2 = paste0("deviation_", human_coders[2]),
    sev_rc      = paste0("concerns_", rc_coder),
    sev_coder_1 = paste0("concerns_", human_coders[1]),
    sev_coder_2 = paste0("concerns_", human_coders[2])
  )

# Were there any deviations that only RegCheck identified?
rq2b_wide_RC_only_dev <- rq2b_wide %>%
  filter(rc == 2 & coder_1 != 2 & coder_2 != 2)

# Total dimension comparisons (denominator)
n_total <- nrow(rq2b_wide)

# Calculate proportion with Wilson's CIs 
rc_identified_prop <- prop.test(nrow(rq2b_wide_RC_only_dev), n = n_total, correct = FALSE)

tibble(
  "proportion" = rc_identified_prop$estimate,
  "lower_ci" = rc_identified_prop$conf.int[1],
  "upper_ci" = rc_identified_prop$conf.int[2]
)
```


```{r eval = FALSE}
# Load pilot round 2 data
round2_data <- read_csv("regcheck_validation_round2_check_test.csv")

# Pivot long and clean
round2_long <- round2_data %>% 
  rename_with(
    ~ str_replace(.x, "deviation_accuracy_(\\d)_3_TEXT", "deviation_accuracy_text_\\1"),
    matches("_3_TEXT")
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = matches("_\\d$"),
    names_to  = c(".value", "dim_num"),
    names_pattern = "^(.+)_(\\d)$"
  ) %>%
  mutate(dim_num = as.integer(dim_num)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(dimension) & dimension != "")

denom_rc <- nrow(round2_long)

# % RC flagged that were *not* deviations
rc_false_pos <- round2_long %>% 
  filter(deviation_accuracy == "No, the deviation RegCheck identified was not accurate.")
rc_fp_prop <- prop.test(nrow(rc_false_pos), n = denom_rc, correct = FALSE)

# % RC flagged that *were* deviations
rc_true_pos <- round2_long %>% 
  filter(deviation_accuracy == "Yes, RegCheck identified a true deviation.")
rc_tp_prop <- prop.test(nrow(rc_true_pos), n = denom_rc, correct = FALSE)

# For completeness, 'Other' category
rc_other <- round2_long %>% 
  filter(deviation_accuracy == "Other")
rc_other_prop <- prop.test(nrow(rc_other), n = denom_rc, correct = FALSE)

# Combined table
bind_rows(
  tibble(category = "True positive",  proportion = rc_tp_prop$estimate,    lower_ci = rc_tp_prop$conf.int[1],    upper_ci = rc_tp_prop$conf.int[2]),
  tibble(category = "False positive", proportion = rc_fp_prop$estimate,    lower_ci = rc_fp_prop$conf.int[1],    upper_ci = rc_fp_prop$conf.int[2]),
  tibble(category = "Other",          proportion = rc_other_prop$estimate, lower_ci = rc_other_prop$conf.int[1], upper_ci = rc_other_prop$conf.int[2])
)

"Severity counts for true positives"
rc_true_pos %>%
  count(deviation_severity, sort = TRUE)
```

### [WIP] Part 2. Deviations RegCheck misses
```{r eval = FALSE}
fn_one  <- rq2b_wide %>% filter(rc != 2 | is.na(rc), coder_1 == 2 | coder_2 == 2)
fn_both <- rq2b_wide %>% filter(rc != 2 | is.na(rc), coder_1 == 2, coder_2 == 2)

rc_missed <- fn_one %>% mutate(fn_type = "one_coder") %>%
  bind_rows(fn_both %>% mutate(fn_type = "both_coders")) %>%
  mutate(
    severity_label = case_when(
      fn_type == "one_coder"   & coder_1 == 2 ~ sev_coder_1,
      fn_type == "one_coder"   & coder_2 == 2 ~ sev_coder_2,
      fn_type == "both_coders" & sev_coder_1 == sev_coder_2 ~ sev_coder_1,
      fn_type == "both_coders" ~ "Coders disagreed",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    severity_label = case_when(
      str_detect(severity_label, "serious")          ~ "Red",
      str_detect(severity_label, "some significant") ~ "Orange",
      str_detect(severity_label, "don")              ~ "Green",
      TRUE ~ severity_label
    )
  )

overall <- rc_missed %>%
  count(fn_type)

severity_rows <- rc_missed %>%
  filter(!is.na(severity_label)) %>%
  count(fn_type, severity_label)

# Overall with CIs
overall %>%
  mutate(pct = n / n_total) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = fn_type, values_from = c(n, pct)) %>%
  mutate(
    ci_lower_one  = map_dbl(n_one_coder,   ~ prop.test(.x, n_total, correct = FALSE)$conf.int[1]),
    ci_upper_one  = map_dbl(n_one_coder,   ~ prop.test(.x, n_total, correct = FALSE)$conf.int[2]),
    ci_lower_both = map_dbl(n_both_coders, ~ prop.test(.x, n_total, correct = FALSE)$conf.int[1]),
    ci_upper_both = map_dbl(n_both_coders, ~ prop.test(.x, n_total, correct = FALSE)$conf.int[2])
  ) %>%
  select(pct_one_coder = pct_one_coder, ci_lower_one, ci_upper_one,
         pct_both_coders = pct_both_coders, ci_lower_both, ci_upper_both)

# Severity breakdown
overall_counts <- overall %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = fn_type, values_from = n) %>%
  rename(n_one_coder = one_coder, n_both_coders = both_coders)

severity_rows %>%
  mutate(pct = case_when(
    fn_type == "one_coder"   ~ n / overall_counts$n_one_coder,
    fn_type == "both_coders" ~ n / overall_counts$n_both_coders
  )) %>%
  select(severity_label, fn_type, pct) %>%
  complete(severity_label, fn_type) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = fn_type, values_from = pct) %>%
  mutate(
    one_coder   = if_else(severity_label == "Coders disagreed", "-",
                          format(round(one_coder, 3), nsmall = 3)),
    both_coders = format(round(both_coders, 3), nsmall = 3)
  ) %>%
  arrange(severity_label == "Coders disagreed") %>%
  select(severity_label, one_coder, both_coders) %>%
  rename(severity = severity_label, `% one coder` = one_coder, `% both coders` = both_coders)
```


## [WIP] RQ3: Agreement x hyperparameter
Note: this will require some cleaning to get the dataframe below (this data frame was simulated)
```{r eval = FALSE}
# Load example data
data_rq3 <- read_csv("data_rq3_simulated.csv")

data_rq3 <- data_rq3 %>%
  mutate(
    llm = case_when(
      !is.na(reasoning_effort) ~ paste0(llm, "_", reasoning_effort),
      !is.na(temperature)      ~ paste0(llm, "_temp", temperature),
      TRUE                     ~ llm
    )
  )

# Build a combined hyperparameter predictor 
data_rq3 <- data_rq3 %>%
  mutate(
    parser         = factor(parser,        levels = c("GROBID", "DPT-2")),
    embedding      = factor(embedding,     levels = c("text-embedding-3-large",
                                                       "text-embedding-3-small",
                                                       "Qwen3-Embedding-8B")),
    llm            = factor(llm,           levels = c("GPT-5.1_high",
                                                       "GPT-5.1_medium",
                                                       "GPT-5.1_low",
                                                       "gpt-oss-120b_high",
                                                       "gpt-oss-120b_medium",
                                                       "gpt-oss-120b_low",
                                                       "Llama-3.3-70B_temp0",
                                                       "Llama-3.3-70B_temp0.5",
                                                       "Llama-3.3-70B_temp1")),
    append_outputs = factor(append_outputs, levels = c("No", "Yes"))
  )

# RQ3a: Cosine similarity hyperparameters
m_rq3_cosine <- lmer(
  cosine ~ parser + embedding + llm + append_outputs +
    (1 | article_num) + (1 | dimension) + (1 | human_coder) +  (1 | paper_id:dimension:human_coder),
  data = data_rq3
)
summary(m_rq3_cosine)

# Marginal means per predictor
emmeans(m_rq3_cosine, ~ parser)
emmeans(m_rq3_cosine, ~ embedding)
emmeans(m_rq3_cosine, ~ llm)
emmeans(m_rq3_cosine, ~ append_outputs)

# RQ3b: Deviation agreement hyperparameters
m_rq3_agree <- glmer(
  deviation_agree ~ parser + embedding + llm + append_outputs +
    (1 | article_num) + (1 | dimension) + (1 | human_coder) +  (1 | paper_id:dimension:human_coder),
  data   = data_rq3,
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)
summary(m_rq3_agree)

# Marginal means per predictor (probability scale)
emmeans(m_rq3_agree, ~ parser,         type = "response")
emmeans(m_rq3_agree, ~ embedding,      type = "response")
emmeans(m_rq3_agree, ~ llm,            type = "response")
emmeans(m_rq3_agree, ~ append_outputs, type = "response")
```
